client_providers.label: Google Sheet ratebook and client tables
client_providers.purpose: Reads owner-verified Rates, Subscribers, Scheme, and Visits data.
clientProvides: Spreadsheet ID and approved columns/field mapping
Showroom timezone Asia/Kolkata and named staff owner
client_providers.secretDestination: Google OAuth/service-account credential in client-owned n8n Credentials.
steps: Create the four named tabs and enter synthetic fixtures.
Connect the sheet read adapter and verify current-day rate freshness.

client_providers.label: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (optional)
client_providers.purpose: Can receive opt-in customer requests and queue approved rate/reminder drafts.

System-user token (enter only in vault), opt-in list and opt-out process
client_providers.secretDestination: Meta credential in client n8n Credentials; do not paste token in Aria form.
steps: Complete client provider onboarding and map a secure webhook.
Keep broadcast/send nodes paused until showroom owner approval.

client_providers.label: OpenAI / approved AI provider (optional)
